headline: ⏳ THE 12:30 TOUR IS FIVE HOURS AWAY AND NOT ONE OF THE THREE HOUSES HAS A SHOWING REQUEST AGAINST IT — a fourteen-day sweep of this feed returns zero hits on all three addresses, and the buyers were pre-approved on 8/19. ⭐ SEPARATELY AND STILL UNPAID: the two agents who walked 225 Willow Point yesterday morning have now gone roughly twenty-three and nineteen hours without a call, and no feedback form is coming on that address, ever. 🔍 Nothing new landed in this feed overnight — the last event was Saturday's 3:00 PM tour at Ridge Trail, and that read has not come back yet.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THREE TOURS IN TWENTY-ONE HOURS ON A LISTING THAT HAD NEVER BEEN SHOWN. Lindsey H. of Epique walked it 9:00–9:30 Saturday morning; Anna C. of A Squared Properties walked it 12:00–12:30, booked only four hours ahead; a third agent booked 4:00 PM and cancelled ten minutes later. Two different brokerages inside one morning, on top of Friday's first-ever 4:30.
hotSignals.action: 🔴 THE OVERNIGHT PASSED AND NEITHER AGENT WAS CALLED — Lindsey H.'s tour ended about twenty-three hours ago and Anna C.'s about nineteen. ⭐ No feedback form exists on this address and none is coming, because it has never sent a REQUESTED notice in its life. Ask each the same two questions: how did it show against what else they are seeing, and is the number right. 🎯 DO IT BEFORE 12:30 — you are running that same family's buyer tour today, and walking in knowing how their own house showed changes the conversation.

hotSignals.signal: ⚖️ THE COUNTER IS LIVE AND THE DECISION LANDS TODAY. Your seller approved the $443,000 counter Saturday at 9:01 — “we are good to go with your recommendation” — it went to the buyer's agent at 10:00 with the furniture carve-out and was acknowledged at 10:01. The buyers' last number was $434,000; you recommended $440,000 best-and-final at 2:26 PM and the seller answered “mom wants to sleep on it.”
hotSignals.action: ⏰ THE BUYER'S AGENT ASKED “Any word?” AT 6:54 LAST NIGHT AND IS STILL WAITING. ⭐ Give him a STATUS, not a number — the seller rules after church, and quoting a figure before that is negotiating against your own client. 🔍 The two sides are about $9,000 apart. ⚠️ Keep saying the real risk out loud: these buyers must close their own house first, which makes this a contingency rather than a closing.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 STILL THE BEST BUYER READ ON THE BOARD AND NOW ON DAY EIGHT. Amy G. of Ethos International filed interested — YES and wrote that her buyers have just started looking, really like the property, and it is at the TOP of their list. She also phoned from inside the house mid-showing, so this is a returned call, not a cold one. She left “priced right” blank and reported the basement lights would not come on.
hotSignals.action: 🎯 TODAY IS THE DAY THIS ONE PAYS OR STOPS MATTERING — you are with this seller for four hours this afternoon. Call her first, do not write: what would it take, and what is behind the blank price answer. ⭐ Then take the answer straight into that meeting, and get the basement lights explained by the only man who knows — day eight on the one complaint nobody has addressed.

hotSignals.signal: 🔍 A FIFTH TOUR HELD SATURDAY AT 3:00 PM FROM AN AGENT WHO HAD NEVER SHOWN THE HOUSE — the first since Thursday's read, and the fifth in thirteen days. Separately and stronger: Adin D. texted you directly, named his gap under the ask, asked you to save his number as a standing investor buyer, and wrote “Happy to have you represent me.”
hotSignals.action: ⭐ THE FIFTH READ HAS NOT COME BACK YET AND THIS ADDRESS DOES RETURN FORMS — two of the last four showings produced written feedback, so it is worth one more day before treating the silence as an answer. 🎯 Meanwhile call Adin, then take the four-read stack plus a same-day tour to the institutional seller. The ask is not a debate anymore, and the last agent handed you a lever that is not a price cut: a pre-inspection.

hotSignals.signal: 🔥 THE STRONGEST SINGLE WORD ANY AGENT HAS FILED ON THIS BOARD, AND IT IS NOW FOURTEEN DAYS OLD. Wanda W. of Millennium Homes answered the interest question with “Very” — not yes, very — on a weekend when two other agents in the same 24 hours filed not interested.
hotSignals.action: Call her. Fourteen days of silence on a “very” is the cheapest loss on this whole board, and she is the only one of the three who wanted it. ⚠️ This is the last week the call is still warm — and check the live post that is still quoting the old price on this address before anyone dials off it.

upcoming: 🔴 TODAY 12:30 PM — THE BUYER TOUR, AND NOTHING IS BOOKED. Three houses in Alabaster, Alabaster and Pelham for a family pre-approved on 8/19. Whoever runs it, somebody has to book three doors first, and the handoff currently exists in one text message to a third party.

📅 TODAY 2:00 PM — MEADOW BROOK WITH THE 355 COMANCHE SELLER. Four hours of the best client time available to you this week. ⭐ Call Amy G. before this, not after — her buyers have his house at the top of their list with no stated objection.

⏰ FRI 8/28 4:00 PM — 195 LAKE VIEW CIR closes, at the title firm's Moody office; they put that date in writing, so the 8/31 the brokerage system still prints is the stale one. 🔴 Three items are open in a thread nobody has answered for roughly 62 hours: survey, home warranty, septic/sewer inspection. ⭐ SEPTIC HAS LEAD TIME — a problem found on the 27th does not close on the 28th. Five days left and the reply is already drafted.

📅 SAT 8/30 — 833 MADISON LN goes live. Nothing is booked because it is not on the market yet. ⭐ THE WEEKEND IS THE ARGUMENT FOR PRE-BOOKING IT: Willow Point sat three days with paid ads running and no tours, then took three in twenty-one hours once the market found it.

📆 FRI 10/23 — 1709 FIELDSTONE CIR closes. Longest runway on the board. The roof scope came back and any licensed roofer is acceptable; the reply is drafted and the buyers moved on a Saturday, so matching their pace today is cheap.
